units.source_text: 于是左马头当了裁判博士，大发议论。

en.t: So the Captain of the Left Division took on the role of judge and launched into a lengthy argument.

units.source_text: 头中将想听到这优劣评判的结果，热心地怂恿他讲。

en.t: The Lieutenant General wanted to hear the outcome of this judgment of merits and faults, and eagerly urged him to speak.
